title: Oversight Error Taxonomy: A Standardized Classification of Overseer Failure Modes

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A standard error taxonomy enables targeted research on which failures propagate most severely. Directly supports the overseer bias mapping priority identified by Anthropic. Clear chain to improved oversight design.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Literature review and taxonomy construction is conceptually accessible but requires reading many papers and synthesizing findings. Less technical but more research-intensive. Suitable for CS students with guidance on reading safety literature.
